name: Doctor's Best Magnesium Glycinate Lysinate
ingredients_text: Magnesium (as TRAACS magnesium lysinate glycinate chelate), microcrystalline cellulose, modified cellulose, magnesium stearate. Gluten-free, soy-free, non-GMO.
description: Chelated magnesium for absorption. Supports bone, muscle, heart, and nervous system function. Glycinate-lysinate chelate form is among the best-tolerated and highest-bioavailability magnesium forms.
